synopsis:
Kyuuko is a young fox girl born to a divine fox messenger and a human. Surrounded by her eight talented and beautiful older siblings, who all adore her, Kyuuko can't help but feel ordinary by comparison. She also struggles to use Charm, the foxes' special power of transformation.

Although her childhood friend Haru accepts and loves her just as she is, Kyuuko still lacks confidence in herself. As she learns to overcome her insecurities, she also helps the humans, foxes, divine messengers, and even gods around her with their own worries.

This heartwarming comedy follows Kyuuko's everyday adventures as she gradually learns to accept herself while bringing smiles to those around her.

(Source: MAL News)
